title: EXP-086 - Hello World Part 5 Section 5 Step 8: Clear the FX_Orders Combobox Right-Click Menus and Test the Item and Customer ID Drill-Downs
objective: Follow hello-world-pt5.md Section 5 step 8 and the start of Section 6 (07:49-08:15 and the right-click test), adapted to FX_ names and User scope. In the Web Designer on the FX_Orders Form, clear the component-level Right-Click Menu StdDefault of FX_ItemCombobox and FX_CustomerIDCombobox (the EXP-069-R2 route: select the value, press Delete, move focus, verify blank) so that both inherit StdDetailsAddFind from the FX_Item and FX_CustomerID Property Class Extensions created in EXP-085. Perform one Designer Save and verify after one Designer close/reopen. Then, in the Web Client (read-only), close and reopen the runtime FX_Orders Form, load the orders with one blank-criteria query and, on order 1 (Customer ID FX001, Item dumbbell), right-click each combobox once and verify the menu offers Add..., Details..., Find... (EXP-069-R4 showed Add..., Details..., Find..., Help). Choose Details once on each: the Item drill-down must open the FX_Items Form on dumbbell (45 pound iron) and the Customer ID drill-down the FX_HelloWorld01 Form on FX001; close each drill-down Form clean. Findings are observed only.

in_scope: Read AGENTS.md, docs/mongoose/transcripts/hello-world-pt5.md Sections 4-6 (05:05-08:15 and the right-click test), the EXP-085 record and outcome (the two extensions and the comboboxes' StdDefault baseline), the EXP-069-R2 T6-T8 sections (the StdDefault override, clearing it with Delete, the Help-only and 25-item menus, menu dismissal) and the EXP-069-R4 record and outcome (the Add/Details/Find menu, the Details drill-down opening a new tab, no unload needed) and the EXP-083 record (runtime FX_Orders, blank-criteria query, row-number navigation) before browser interaction.
Create or update only experiments/EXP-086-hello-world-part-5-section-5-step-8-fx-orders-right-click-drill-downs.md and evidence/EXP-086/ documentation and evidence files.
Record the worker-written-file inventory and a cumulative browser action audit with exact counts.

Use the existing authenticated session without refresh, restart or configuration change. If it expires, follow the worker-preamble session-expiry procedure once and end the task; never sign in inside the portal's embedded app frame (refused, EXP-080-R2) but use the procedure's top-level portal navigation. List the browser tabs before the first tab selection. Answer any prompt within the same task; never leave a prompt or menu open across tasks.

Designer preflight: the Designer is in User scope and clean on FX_Orders (open it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry if needed). Record for FX_ItemCombobox and FX_CustomerIDCombobox the Binding, the Inheritance values (expected FX_Item and FX_CustomerID) and the component-level Behavior values Add/Details Form, Find Form, Property (expected blank) and Right-Click Menu (expected StdDefault). If either Right-Click Menu is already blank or differs, record it and stop blocked.

Runtime baseline (read-only): in the Web Client, if FX_Orders is open close it once (clean); open it once through Form > Open > Select Form, record the mode, switch to Filter in Place if needed, leave every criterion blank and press F4 once; on order 1 right-click the Item combobox once, record the menu items with a screenshot and dismiss with one Escape and, if still open, one click on blank Form space; repeat once for the Customer ID combobox. Never choose a menu item in the baseline.

Override: select FX_ItemCombobox in the Details > Components grid, select its Right-Click Menu value StdDefault, press Delete once to clear the text, move focus away (Tab once) and verify the cell reads blank; verify Add/Details Form, Find Form, Property and Inheritance unchanged. Repeat for FX_CustomerIDCombobox. Never choose a value from the Right-Click Menu list.
Perform exactly one Designer Save through the native toolbar Save and record the native response verbatim; if Save is disabled after the two clears, record it and stop blocked.

Close the clean FX_Orders Designer Form once through its Form-tab control and reopen it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry; verify both component-level Right-Click Menus blank and all other recorded values unchanged.

Runtime check: close the clean runtime FX_Orders Form once and reopen it once as in the baseline (blank-criteria F4 once); on order 1 right-click the Item combobox once and record the menu items verbatim with a screenshot, dismiss without choosing; repeat for the Customer ID combobox.

Cache contingency, only if the runtime check shows no Details, Add or Find on a combobox: close the clean runtime FX_Orders Form, invoke the Web Client Form > Definition > Unload All Global Form Objects once (no runtime Form dirty), reopen FX_Orders once, run the blank-criteria F4 once and right-click each combobox once more. Never use the Designer unload.

Drill-downs: on order 1, right-click the Item combobox and choose Details once; verify the FX_Items Form opens on dumbbell (description 45 pound iron) and record its tab, record position and mode; close that FX_Items Form once (clean, no edits). Then right-click the Customer ID combobox and choose Details once; verify the FX_HelloWorld01 Form opens on FX001 and record its other visible values; close it once (clean). Return to the runtime FX_Orders Form and verify it is clean and still on order 1.
Close the runtime FX_Orders Form once at the end; if a close prompt asks to save a new record, answer No once and record it.

Capture screenshots of the Designer preflight Behavior values, each baseline runtime menu, each cleared Right-Click Menu, the Save, the reopened Designer readback, each runtime menu after the change, each drill-down Form and the final state.
Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection. Classify findings as observed only.
out_of_scope: Changing the FX_Item, FX_CustomerID or FX_UM extensions; any component property other than the two Right-Click Menu values; captions, strings, layout or other Forms.
Choosing Add or Find from a right-click menu; any runtime edit, New, Save or Delete; editing the drill-down Forms.
Sections 7-13 (validators, component classes, the final unload).
The FX_Orders IDO, property classes, SQL objects and runtime data.
Check Out, Check In, Undo Check Out or other checkout-management actions; FormSync, deployment or regeneration; the Designer unload or IDO metadata unloads.
Direct SQL or script execution, browser JavaScript, console or network inspection, direct URL navigation (except the portal step of the session-expiry procedure), refresh or restart.
Modifying earlier experiment records, AGENTS.md, tutorial sources, recipes or files outside the EXP-086 paths.

prohibited_actions: Creating, modifying or deleting any non-FX_ artifact
Starting any other experiment or replay
Modifying production data or disabling security
Never change any component property other than the Right-Click Menu of FX_ItemCombobox and FX_CustomerIDCombobox, and never set it to a value; it is only cleared.
Never change, create or remove a property class extension, property class or component.
Never invoke the Designer Save more than once or retry an uncertain Save.
Never invoke more than one Web Client Unload All Global Form Objects, only under the contingency condition, and never the Designer one.
Never choose Add or Find in a right-click menu; choose Details at most once per combobox and never in the baseline.
Never type into runtime fields, choose list values, press New, Save or Delete at runtime, or edit a drill-down Form.
Never close a dirty Form or discard changes without operator approval (the runtime close prompt for an unsaved new record is answered No once, as allowed in scope).
Never click the Designer top-toolbar Delete button (Delete Form Definition) or Regenerate Form.
Never perform check-in, undo checkout or other checkout-management actions, FormSync or deployment.

Never use direct SQL, scripts, application internals or browser JavaScript; never refresh, restart or replace the browser session; re-login only through the worker-preamble session-expiry procedure, at most once per task.
Never claim cross-session durability or replay verification from same-session UI observations.

artifacts: FX_Orders (User-scoped Designer Form; one Save; runtime read-only apart from two Details drill-downs)

acceptance_checks.description: Sources reviewed; session usable; Designer FX_Orders in User scope and clean; both comboboxes show Inheritance FX_Item / FX_CustomerID, blank Add/Details Form, Find Form and Property, and Right-Click Menu StdDefault; the baseline runtime menus on order 1 recorded without choosing an item. Evidence: Designer and baseline-menu screenshots.

Both component-level Right-Click Menus cleared (blank after focus moved), all other values unchanged; exactly one Designer Save with its native response verbatim; after one Designer close/reopen both read blank. Evidence: clear, Save and reopen screenshots.

After one runtime close/reopen and one blank-criteria F4, the Item and Customer ID right-click menus on order 1 each offer Details, Add and Find; the contingency unload used at most once and only under its condition. Evidence: menu screenshots and the unload count.

Details on the Item combobox opens FX_Items on dumbbell (45 pound iron); Details on the Customer ID combobox opens FX_HelloWorld01 on FX001; both drill-down Forms closed clean; FX_Orders still clean on order 1 and closed once at the end. Evidence: drill-down screenshots.

The final EXP-086 report gives decisive evidence for AC-1 to AC-4, the complete action audit with exact counts (Right-Click Menu clears 2, Designer Save 1, Designer close/reopen 1, runtime opens and closes, F4 count, right-clicks, Details 2, Add/Find 0, unloads, zero other component changes, zero runtime edits, zero checkout actions, re-login count), the worker-written-file inventory and the final state. Repository confinement is supported by worker/harness inventories, with operator git review authoritative. Findings are observed only.

initial_instruction: T1 - Read-only preflight and baseline for EXP-086. Review AGENTS.md, hello-world-pt5.md Sections 4-6, the EXP-085 record and outcome, the EXP-069-R2 T6-T8 sections, the EXP-069-R4 record and outcome and the EXP-083 record. Without shell/git access, record the starting state concisely. List the browser tabs before selecting one; identify the Web Client and Web Designer tabs. If either shows a session expiry or sign-in, follow the worker-preamble procedure (top-level portal navigation only) and end the task. In the Designer confirm User scope and a clean FX_Orders Form (open it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry if needed) and record, for FX_ItemCombobox and FX_CustomerIDCombobox, the Binding, Inheritance and component-level Behavior values (Add/Details Form, Find Form, Property, Right-Click Menu) without changing anything. In the Web Client perform the runtime baseline: close FX_Orders once if open (clean), open it once through Form > Open > Select Form, leave criteria blank and press F4 once; on order 1 right-click the Item combobox once, record the menu with a screenshot and dismiss it without choosing; then the same for the Customer ID combobox. Create the EXP-086 record with the baseline, the action audit and the worker-written-file inventory, with screenshots under evidence/EXP-086/. Stop before changing any Right-Click Menu.
